title: Release 2.0.4: Auth service criticality downgrade
body:
Version bump to 2.0.4 following the auth service criticality change from `required` to `core`.

## Changes

- **Version**: All packages bumped from 2.0.3 → 2.0.4 (fixed versioning)
- **Core change**: `ServiceRequirementDef.auth` downgraded from `required` to `core` criticality
  - System now warns instead of failing when auth service is missing
  - Enables degraded mode operation without authentication
- **Changelog**: Updated across all 23 packages in monorepo

## Technical Detail

The criticality level change in `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts`:

```typescript
export const ServiceRequirementDef = {
  // Required: The kernel cannot function without these
  metadata: 'required',
  data: 'required',

  // Core: Highly recommended, defaults to in-memory / no-op if missing
  auth: 'core',  // Changed from 'required'
  
  // ...
} as const;
```

This allows the ObjectStack kernel to start without authentication services, falling back to no-op or in-memory implementations. System logs warnings for missing core services instead of hard failure.

## Publishing

Automated via GitHub Actions on merge to main. Packages will publish to npm with the updated version and changelog entries.
